title: Automation Anywhere Bot
description: Schema representing a bot (automation file) stored in the Automation Anywhere Control Room repository, including its metadata, versioning, workspace context, and repository permissions.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the bot file in the Control Room repository

parentId.description: Numeric ID of the parent folder containing this bot in the repository hierarchy

name.description: Display name of the bot file as shown in the Control Room repository browser

path.description: Full repository path from the workspace root (e.g., /Automation/Finance/Invoice Processing)

version.description: Current version number of the bot file

isProductionVersion.description: Whether this version is labeled as the production version

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the bot's purpose

dependencies.description: List of other bot files this bot depends on during execution

tags.description: Optional tags applied to the bot for organization and search

createdBy.description: Username of the Control Room user who created this bot

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bot was first created in the repository

updatedBy.description: Username of the Control Room user who last modified this bot

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bot was last modified

ObjectPermission.description: Actions the current authenticated user can perform on this repository object

delete.description: Whether the user can delete this bot from the repository

download.description: Whether the user can download this bot file

upload.description: Whether the user can upload a new version of this bot

run.description: Whether the user can deploy and run this bot

view.description: Whether the user can view this bot in the repository

clone.description: Whether the user can clone (copy) this bot to another location

DependencyRef.description: Reference to a file that this bot depends on

id.description: Numeric ID of the dependency file

name.description: Display name of the dependency file

path.description: Repository path of the dependency file
